title: Instruction regarding the merger of Registered post with Speed Post for domestic transmission.
text:
KEY LINES:
Mail-30/5/2025-D-DOP,
02.07.2025,
01.09.2025,

FULL TEXT:
:
INSTRUCTION
:
No.Judicial/2t
/2025
In
view
of
No.
Mail-30/5/2025-D-DOP,
dated
02.07.2025,
issued
by
the
Department
of Posts,
Government
of
India,
regarding the
merger
of
‘Registered
Post’
with
‘Speed
Post’
for
domestic
transmission
is
to.
be
implemented
we.
01.09.2025,
the
Honourable
the
Chief
Justice
has
been
pleased
to direct
that
all
instances
of
‘Registered
Post’
shall
be
read
as
'Speed
Post'
with
effect
from
the
date
of
implementation by
the
Postal
Authority,
until
necessary
amendments
are
made
to
the Gujarat High Court
Rules,
1993.
All
concerned
Stakeholders
and
Staff
Members
are
requested
to
take note
accordingly.
Date

order
of

the
